3/S0.subgoal: Summarize the general potential and application domains of extended reality technologies.

3/S1.subgoal: Describe the primary application domains for augmented reality.

3/S2.subgoal: Illustrate various augmented reality applications through specific commercial and medical examples.

3/S3.subgoal: Identify the two broad categories of AR applications based on technology.

3/S4.subgoal: Explain the concept, advantages, and limitations of marker-based augmented reality.

3/S5.subgoal: Describe the four subcategories of markerless augmented reality systems.

3/S6.subgoal: Summarize the key differences between VR and AR in terms of application types and system categories.
